SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

2. Which statement about Climatic regions in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Climatic regions in Eastern Africa.
   B. Say Climatic regions in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Climatic regions in Eastern Africa as rumours only.

3. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

   A. Explain Historic Built Environments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

   D. Say Historic Built Environments never happens in Kenya.

8. Which statement about Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa.
   C. Treat Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa as rumours only.
   D. Explain Position and Size of Countries in Eastern Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Main physical features in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Climatic regions in Eastern Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
